clips.title: The story
paras: A Lack of Fear is a rite-of-passage summons for dwarven priests, calling promising disciples back to the grand halls of Ironforge. High Priest Rohan awaits in the Mystic Ward to test their discipline and bestow teachings tailored to their growing resilience.

Priests serving the Alliance abroad are routinely directed by their local mentors to report back to their order's senior clergy. For dwarven disciples, that guidance leads straight to High Priest Rohan in the heart of Ironforge's Mystic Ward. The summons marks a turning point where basic spiritual practice gives way to deeper, trial-tested applications of holy magic.

High Priest Rohan does not simply teach liturgy; dwarven tradition views the Light as a shield and an unyielding bulwark in physical conflict. Reporting for this test acknowledges that the initiate has survived baptism through fire in the wider world and possesses the mettle required to master fear itself on the front lines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your High Priest Rohan would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my strong friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Rohan should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. He will be waiting.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've got the makings of a great adventurer, friend. Keep up the good work!
You've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
